items.before: Review sections and cards are renamed, and the extra headings above cards are gone
items.after: Review sections and cards are renamed. The extra headings above cards are gone.

items.before: Before, the review had a heading above each card, such as 'Where is this consignment coming from?' and 'Roles and addresses'. Now each card sits straight under its numbered section, with card titles one level below. Section 4 is '4. Uploaded documents', section 5 is '5. Consignment addresses' with one 'Addresses' card, and section 6 holds a 'Contact address' card. Cards are titled 'Origin of import', 'Main import reason' and 'Additional details'.
items.after:
Before, the review had a heading above each card, such as:
- 'Where is this consignment coming from?'
- 'Roles and addresses'

Now each card sits straight under its numbered section.

Card titles are one level below.

Sections:
- section 4 is '4. Uploaded documents'
- section 5 is '5. Consignment addresses', with one 'Addresses' card
- section 6 holds a 'Contact address' card

Cards are titled:
- 'Origin of import'
- 'Main import reason'
- 'Additional details'

items.before: Review sections and cards take Design Release 2.1's headings, titles and unfinished-card messages
items.after: Review sections and cards use the headings, titles and unfinished-card messages from Design Release 2.1

items.before: An unfinished card's message now follows its new title, on the card and in the error summary: 'Complete origin of import', 'Complete what are you importing?', 'Complete main import reason', 'Complete additional details' and 'Complete commodity details'. When more than one species needs identification, each species short of a number or an identifier is named, for example 'Enter at least 1 animal identifier for bos taurus', and the link goes to that species.
items.after:
An unfinished card's message now follows its new title.

This shows on the card and in the error summary:
- 'Complete origin of import'
- 'Complete what are you importing?'
- 'Complete main import reason'
- 'Complete additional details'
- 'Complete commodity details'

Sometimes more than one species needs identification. Then each species missing a number or an identifier is named.

For example, 'Enter at least 1 animal identifier for bos taurus'.

The link goes to that species.

items.before: Review sections and cards take Design Release 2.1's headings, titles and unfinished-card messages
items.after: Review sections and cards use the headings, titles and unfinished-card messages from Design Release 2.1

items.before: Review reads the commodity selection back in a 'What are you importing?' card and groups species under their commodity
items.after: The review shows the chosen commodities in a 'What are you importing?' card. It groups species under their commodity.

items.before: Identification details on the review: heading, animal labels, its own Change link and per-species unfinished messages
items.after: Identification details on the review get a heading, animal labels, their own Change link and unfinished messages for each species

items.before: Before, each species had its own card repeating the commodity code, name and species. Now section 1 has a 'What are you importing?' card listing the commodity code, common name and species once. Section 2 has one card per commodity, titled with its name and code, holding a block for each species with the number of animals and, where asked, 'Number of packages (when required)'. Species names are shown with every word capitalised, for example 'Bos Taurus'. The card has a Change link at the top, and each species block's first row has its own Change link to the same page.
items.after:
Before, each species had its own card. Each card repeated the commodity code, name and species.

Now section 1 has a 'What are you importing?' card. It lists the commodity code, common name and species once.

Section 2 has one card per commodity:
- the card is titled with the commodity's name and code
- it holds a block for each species
- each block shows the number of animals
- where asked, each block also shows 'Number of packages (when required)'

Species names are shown with every word capitalised, for example 'Bos Taurus'.

Change links:
- the card has a Change link at the top
- each species block's first row has its own Change link to the same page

items.before: Review reads the commodity selection back in a 'What are you importing?' card and groups species under their commodity
items.after: The review shows the chosen commodities in a 'What are you importing?' card. It groups species under their commodity.

items.before: Each species block's identifier table is now headed 'Identification details', each animal is labelled by its species and number under an 'Animal' column, and the table has its own Change link to the identification page.
items.after:
Each species block has an identifier table. Now:
- the table is headed 'Identification details'
- each animal is labelled by its species and number, under an 'Animal' column
- the table has its own Change link to the identification page

items.before: Identification details on the review: heading, animal labels, its own Change link and per-species unfinished messages
items.after: Identification details on the review get a heading, animal labels, their own Change link and unfinished messages for each species

items.before: The origin card now always shows 'Region of origin code', reading 'Not applicable' when none was needed, and drops the 'Region of origin code required' row. For a transit import, the reason card shows 'Exit border control post' and 'Destination country' instead of 'Port of exit'. The additional details card shows only when it has something to show, with a Change link only when that page is part of the notification's journey.
items.after:
The origin card:
- now always shows 'Region of origin code'
- reads 'Not applicable' when no code was needed
- drops the 'Region of origin code required' row

For a transit import, the reason card shows 'Exit border control post' and 'Destination country'. These replace 'Port of exit'.

The additional details card shows only when it has something to show.

It has a Change link only when that page is part of the notification's journey.

items.before: Arrival and transport cards read back the way the questions are asked
items.after: Arrival and transport cards use the same words as the questions

items.before: The arrival date row is now 'Arrival date at destination', and the means of transport reads with the question's own words, for example 'Air' instead of 'Airplane'. Transit countries now sit inside the arrival details card, under 'Countries that the consignment will travel through', with their own Change link; there is no separate transit card. The transport details card always shows name, address, country, approval number and type, with 'Not applicable' for anything empty.
items.after:
The arrival date row is now 'Arrival date at destination'.

The means of transport uses the question's own words. For example, 'Air' instead of 'Airplane'.

Transit countries now sit inside the arrival details card:
- under 'Countries that the consignment will travel through'
- with their own Change link

There is no separate transit card.

The transport details card always shows:
- name
- address
- country
- approval number
- type

Anything empty shows 'Not applicable'.

items.before: Before, a consignment travelling by rail or road could not go on to the declaration until transit countries were added. Now the review shows no 'Complete transit countries' message and Continue goes on to the declaration. The overview still shows the Transit countries task as To do until a country is added.
items.after:
Before, a consignment travelling by rail or road could not go on to the declaration until transit countries were added.

Now:
- the review shows no 'Complete transit countries' message
- Continue goes on to the declaration

The overview still shows the Transit countries task as To do until a country is added.

items.before: Before, all documents shared one card and showed the file type. Now each document has its own 'Document 1', 'Document 2' card with its own Change link, showing the reference, type, date of issue and the attached file's name. With nothing uploaded, one 'Document 1' card reads 'Not applicable' in place of 'You have not added any documents yet.'
items.after:
Before, all documents shared one card and showed the file type.

Now each document has its own card, titled 'Document 1', 'Document 2'.

Each card has its own Change link and shows:
- the reference
- the type
- the date of issue
- the attached file's name

With nothing uploaded, one 'Document 1' card reads 'Not applicable'.

This replaces 'You have not added any documents yet.'

items.before: Before, each party's address on the review showed every field, including telephone and email. Now it reads the name, then each address line, town and postcode, then the country, each on its own line, with 'United Kingdom' for GB and no telephone or email. The contact address reads the same way. Plants' check your answers makes the same change to the place of destination, consignor and contact cards, replacing its one-line address joined by commas.
items.after:
Before, each party's address on the review showed every field, including telephone and email.

Now it shows these, each on its own line:
- the name
- each address line, town and postcode
- the country, with 'United Kingdom' for GB

It shows no telephone or email.

The contact address reads the same way.

Plants' check your answers makes the same change to these cards:
- place of destination
- consignor
- contact

This replaces its one-line address joined by commas.

items.before: The review page reads each party's copied address back as name, address lines and country, in live animals and plants
items.after: In live animals and plants, the review page shows each party's copied address as name, address lines and country

items.before: Before, a draft's review was headed 'Review your notification' under the status strip. Now it is headed by the notification reference with a 'Draft' tag and 'Date created', and offers 'Copy as new' and a red 'Delete' at the top, followed by the 'Import reference numbers' section. The page stays editable, lists anything unfinished, and ends with Continue. Back goes to the notification list. Plants' draft check your answers takes the same header, without 'Copy as new'.
items.after:
Before, a draft's review was headed 'Review your notification' under the status strip.

Now the top of the page shows:
- the notification reference as the heading, with a 'Draft' tag and 'Date created'
- 'Copy as new'
- a red 'Delete'

The 'Import reference numbers' section follows.

The page:
- stays editable
- lists anything unfinished
- ends with Continue

Back goes to the notification list.

Plants' draft check your answers takes the same header, without 'Copy as new'.

items.before: Review ends with Continue and Delete, and an amendment's review offers Cancel amend and tells the trader they are re-submitting
items.after: The review ends with 'Continue' and 'Delete'. An amendment's review also offers 'Cancel amend' and tells the trader they are re-submitting.
